info.title: RealtimeX CLI API
info.description: Action-first API endpoints for the generated RealtimeX CLI and agent skill. UI supplied by Swagger.io.

get.description: Return compact workspace, thread, current workspace/thread from explicit workspaceSlug and threadSlug query parameters, LLM provider, model, and CLI agent context for agents before choosing arguments. Agents should pass --workspace-slug "$RTX_WORKSPACE_SLUG" and --thread-slug "$RTX_THREAD_SLUG" when those environment variables exist.

parameters.name: workspaceSlug
parameters.description: Current workspace slug from the caller context. Pass the RTX_WORKSPACE_SLUG environment value here when available.

parameters.name: threadSlug
parameters.description: Current thread slug from the caller context. Pass the RTX_THREAD_SLUG environment value here when available.

get.description: Set up AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md personality files for a workspace or global ambient agent. Returns the target path, template, file paths, and concise editing instructions.

parameters.name: workspaceSlug
parameters.description: Workspace slug whose personality should be edited. Required when scope=workspace.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Required. Use workspace for a workspace personality, or ambient/global for the global ambient agent personality at the fixed agent-heartbeat workspace.

example: SOUL.md
USER.md
IDENTITY.md
TOOLS.md
MEMORY.md
Create or edit AGENTS.md as the main personality file.
Make CLAUDE.md a symlink to AGENTS.md so Claude reads the same main instructions.
Do not include HEARTBEAT.md in personality; heartbeat instructions will be handled by another CLI operation.
SOUL.md
USER.md
IDENTITY.md
TOOLS.md
MEMORY.md
Create or edit AGENTS.md as the main personality file.
Make CLAUDE.md a symlink to AGENTS.md so Claude reads the same main instructions.
Do not include HEARTBEAT.md in personality; heartbeat instructions will be handled by another CLI operation.

get.description: Set up HEARTBEAT.md task instructions for a workspace or global ambient agent. Returns the target path, template, file path, and concise editing instructions.

parameters.name: workspaceSlug
parameters.description: Workspace slug whose HEARTBEAT.md should be edited. Required when scope=workspace.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Required. Use workspace for a workspace heartbeat, or ambient/global for the global ambient agent HEARTBEAT.md at the fixed agent-heartbeat workspace.

example: Create or edit HEARTBEAT.md for workspace or global ambient-agent heartbeat instructions.
Use HEARTBEAT.md for recurring ambient behavior, periodic checks, proactive routines, and standing background tasks.
Keep heartbeat instructions separate from personality files like AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md.
Use interval for simple task timing, cron for complex schedules, and optional agent/model/skills task fields when needed.

Keep heartbeat instructions separate from personality files like AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md.
Use interval for simple task timing, cron for complex schedules, and optional agent/model/skills task fields when needed.

get.description: List all workspaces visible to the current API caller. Use this before choosing a workspace slug.

post.description: Create a workspace. Requires a human-readable workspace name.

name.description: Required human-readable name. Do not pass a slug here.

get.description: Get one workspace by exact workspace slug.

post.description: Rename one workspace by exact workspace slug. Only the name is changed.

name.description: Required human-readable name. Do not pass a slug here.

delete.description: Delete one workspace by exact workspace slug.

post.description: Set the default CLI agent for a workspace. Use prepare first to find a valid agent canonical/providerId and optional modelId.

canonical.description: Required CLI agent canonical id from prepare.agents, for example claude, codex, gemini, or qwen.

providerId.description: Optional CLI agent provider id from prepare.agents when canonical alone is ambiguous.

modelId.description: Optional model id from the selected prepare.agents entry. Omit only when the user explicitly wants the CLI default model.

reasoning_effort.description: Optional reasoning effort for terminal CLI models that support it, for example low, medium, high, xhigh, or max.

delete.description: Clear the default CLI agent from a workspace.

get.description: List threads for one exact workspace slug.

post.description: Create a thread in one workspace. The name is optional but recommended.

get.description: Get one thread by exact workspace slug and exact thread slug.

post.description: Rename one thread by exact workspace slug and exact thread slug. Only the name is changed.

name.description: Required human-readable name. Do not pass a slug here.

delete.description: Delete one thread by exact workspace slug and exact thread slug.

post.description: Send one message to an exact thread using the same routing as channel replies. Terminal-agent threads are dispatched to the terminal runtime; other threads use the configured LLM chat path.

message.description: Required user message to send to the thread.

attachments.description: Optional attachments using the app chat attachment shape.

webSearchEnabled.description: Optional web search toggle for this one message.

broadcastThreadEvents.description: Broadcast thread events to connected UI subscribers. Defaults to true.

stripAgentPrefixForDelivery.description: Strip @agent prefixes before delivery unless explicitly disabled. Defaults to true.

channelTurnId.description: Optional caller-provided id for correlating this CLI turn.

get.description: List supported LLM providers. Use provider ids from this response when configuring workspace or thread LLM settings.
List models for one provider id. Use an exact model id from this response when configuring workspace or thread LLM settings.
List published agent skills. Use list-workspace-agent-skills to see enabled/disabled state for one workspace.
List published agent skills with enabled/disabled state for one exact workspace slug.

post.description: Enable one agent skill in a workspace. Use a skill id, name, or displayName from list-workspace-agent-skills.
Disable one agent skill in a workspace. Use a skill id, name, or displayName from list-workspace-agent-skills.

Force reload all enabled agent skills into one workspace working directory. Pass workspaceSlug; agents should pass the current RTX_WORKSPACE_SLUG when reloading the current workspace. After files are reloaded, the running agent must reload its own skill context before relying on updated skill instructions.

workspaceSlug.description: Workspace slug to reload skills into. For current workspace, pass RTX_WORKSPACE_SLUG as this value.

get.description: List installed plugins with enabled state and runtime load status. Use returned ids with enable-plugin, disable-plugin, and reload-plugin.

post.description: Enable one installed plugin globally and load it into runtime. Use a plugin id, name, or displayName from list-plugins.
Disable one installed plugin globally and unload it from runtime. Use a plugin id, name, or displayName from list-plugins.
Reload one enabled plugin in runtime. Disabled plugins must be enabled before reload.

get.description: List configured chat channels. Use returned channel ids with update-channel.

post.description: Create a chat channel in one exact workspace. Defaults to Telegram when plugin_type, channelType, and type are omitted. Use flat botToken and thread_id fields instead of nested config/settings.

plugin_type.description: Channel plugin type. Defaults to telegram.

botToken.description: Bot token for telegram, discord, or zalo. The API maps this to config.botToken internally.

thread_id.description: Thread id to attach the channel to. The API maps this to settings.thread_id internally.

autoStart.description: Start the channel immediately after create. Defaults to true.

enabled.description: Compatibility field. Defaults to the autoStart value.

post.description: Update one chat channel by exact channel id. Only channel writable fields are changed.

thread_id.description: Thread id to attach the channel to. Omit to keep the current thread_id.

terminalProgressRelay.description: Enable terminal progress relay. Omit to keep the current value.

terminalProgressThrottleSeconds.description: Terminal progress relay throttle in seconds. Omit to keep the current value.

ttsEnabled.description: Enable channel text-to-speech. Omit to keep the current value.

post.description: Start one chat channel by exact channel id.
Stop one chat channel by exact channel id.

delete.description: Delete one chat channel by exact channel id.

post.description: Approve one pending channel pairing code by visible 6-digit code or database id. Works for telegram, discord, and zalo channel pairing requests.
Turn workspace or global ambient-agent heartbeat on or off.

scope.description: Required. Use workspace for a workspace heartbeat config, or global/ambient for the global ambient-agent heartbeat config.

post.description: Set workspace or global ambient-agent main executor interval. Supports simple intervals only: m, h, or d, for example 3m, 1h, or 1d.

scope.description: Required. Use workspace for a workspace heartbeat config, or global/ambient for the global ambient-agent heartbeat config.

interval.description: Required simple interval using m, h, or d. Examples: 3m, 1h, 1d. Cron is not supported for the main executor interval.

post.description: Set workspace or global ambient-agent active hours using HH:mm start and end values.

scope.description: Required. Use workspace for a workspace heartbeat config, or global/ambient for the global ambient-agent heartbeat config.

start.description: Required active-hours start in HH:mm format, for example 08:00.

end.description: Required active-hours end in HH:mm format, for example 24:00.

post.description: Set workspace or global ambient-agent heartbeat timezone, for example Asia/Saigon or UTC.

scope.description: Required. Use workspace for a workspace heartbeat config, or global/ambient for the global ambient-agent heartbeat config.

timezone.description: Required IANA timezone, for example Asia/Saigon or UTC.

post.description: Turn workspace or global ambient-agent heartbeat auto pilot on or off.

scope.description: Required. Use workspace for a workspace heartbeat config, or global/ambient for the global ambient-agent heartbeat config.

post.description: Set workspace or global ambient-agent main executor default terminal agent and optional model.

scope.description: Required. Use workspace for a workspace heartbeat config, or global/ambient for the global ambient-agent heartbeat config.

canonical.description: Required terminal agent canonical id from prepare.agents, for example codex, gemini, claude, or qwen.

providerId.description: Optional terminal agent provider id from prepare.agents.

modelId.description: Optional model id from the selected prepare.agents entry.

reasoning_effort.description: Optional reasoning effort for terminal CLI models that support it, for example low, medium, high, xhigh, or max.

get.description: List terminal runtime sessions known to the desktop app. Optionally filter by workspaceSlug and threadSlug. workspaceSlug is required when threadSlug is provided.

parameters.name: threadSlug
parameters.description: Optional thread slug filter. Requires workspaceSlug.

parameters.name: includeClosed
parameters.description: Include closed sessions. Defaults to true.

post.description: Resume a terminal runtime session by attaching a CLI controller. If the live session is closed or missing, historical resume metadata is used when available.

workspaceSlug.description: Optional exact workspace slug used to locate closed historical sessions faster.

threadSlug.description: Optional exact thread slug. When provided, workspaceSlug should also be provided.

requestedBy.description: Optional human-readable label for the CLI controller.

post.description: Resume the latest terminal runtime session for one exact thread. workspaceSlug and threadSlug are required in the body or query string.

workspaceSlug.description: Required exact workspace slug containing the terminal session thread.

threadSlug.description: Required exact thread slug whose latest terminal session should resume.

requestedBy.description: Optional human-readable label for the CLI controller.

post.description: Terminate a terminal runtime session by detaching any controller and closing the underlying PTY session.
